name: Aecc Aero-Engine Control Co.,Ltd.
summary: Aecc Aero-Engine Control Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, manufacturing, maintenance, and service of military and civilian aero-engines and gas turbine control systems in China and internationally. The company also provides civilian aviation components, such as aero-engine rocker arms, fuel system valve assemblies, flight control systems, engine pump housing assemblies, and other precision parts.
